verdict.rationale_short: June NFP printed 57K (vs. 110K consensus, below the 80K Goldilocks floor) — the 10%-probability weak scenario materialized, eliminating the Goldilocks BUY upgrade path. SPX closed ~7,453, seven points below the 7,460 regime floor, resetting the dual-gate framework. VIX held at 16.81 (below 17) and July 28 FOMC hike probability collapsed from 33% to ~19.4%, providing rate relief; that rate relief is insufficient against growth-scare headwinds through the 3-day unhedgeable July 4 holiday gap. The SPCX $7.3B forced buying on July 7 (Nasdaq-100 inclusion) is the primary re-entry catalyst; no new positions before July 7 open.

trade_setups.thesis: SPCX dipped from ~$163 pre-market to ~$156 by close, improving the entry for the $7.3B mechanical forced buying on July 7 (Nasdaq-100 inclusion: $4.3B from QQQ/QQQM rebalancing + $3B Russell reweighting). The forced flow executes on a calendar date regardless of macro conditions — neither the 57K NFP growth scare nor the Korea semiconductor shock alters the index rebalancing mandate. Tesla's December 2020 S&P 500 inclusion template: forced-flow events can move inclusion-day stocks 8–15% before stabilizing.
trade_setups.entry: Initiate at ~$156 est.; add on any dip below $150 through the holiday gap. Do not chase the July 7 opening spike — the inclusion day is often a 'sell the spike' event after the forced flow completes.
trade_setups.invalidation: SPCX reverses below $145 on above-average volume (forced flow already priced or lockup expiry selling dominates); OR SPX gaps below 7,300 on July 7 open (macro overwhelms the mechanical bid).
trade_setups.horizon: 3–5 trading days (through July 7 Nasdaq-100 forced buying execution)

trade_setups.thesis: META at $583.50 (-4.81%) is now at the 'better entry' zone of $575–595 cited in briefings since July 1. The AI cloud business announcement (Bloomberg, July 1) remains structurally intact; the pullback reflects sector rotation, not a retraction of the cloud narrative. The 57K NFP weakness paradoxically strengthens the META thesis: rate cuts back on the table lower the discount rate applied to META's $50B+ AI infrastructure spend, and the rate-relief narrative expands the multiple for a $60B+ annual FCF machine. Q2 earnings July 29 is the first management quantification of the cloud business opportunity.
trade_setups.entry: Initiate new long at $575–595 (at target entry zone); add at $565 if offered through the holiday gap. Do not chase above $600 before July 7 macro confirmation.
trade_setups.invalidation: SPX closes below 7,300 (regime deterioration) OR META reverses below $555 on above-average volume (cloud narrative retracted or Q2 warning issued).

trade_setups.thesis: AMD fell 4.3% on July 2 alongside Micron (-7%) and Applied Materials (-7.4%) in the semiconductor sector's worst session in months. Korea's circuit breaker (KOSPI -4.45%, SK Hynix -10.96%) on the Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM narrative extends AI supply chain uncertainty that the broader complex has not yet fully repriced from H1's 80%+ gains. AMD has no standalone catalyst before Q2 earnings (late July), lacks NVDA's Blackwell AI-specificity, and is most exposed to the Dow-vs-Nasdaq rotation (value/defensives outperforming) that July 2's ATH session confirmed.
trade_setups.entry: Short AMD at market (~$507) or on a weak July 7 open bounce; put spread or direct short. Size 15–20% of portfolio hedge allocation.
trade_setups.invalidation: SPCX $7.3B bid lifts all growth/tech names and AMD closes above $540; OR NVDA reclaims $200 on volume, reversing the sector. If SPX reclaims 7,460 AND VIX falls below 16.5, cover the short.

bear_case: NFP printing 57K with -74K combined revisions to April-May signals employment is deteriorating faster than the 'soft landing' narrative acknowledges. At Nasdaq P/E ~28x, the risk of simultaneous slowing growth and sticky inflation (June CPI ~July 14) creates a stagflation scenario — the worst multiple environment for long-duration growth equities. TSLA's sell-the-news pattern (480K delivery beat vs. 406K consensus, stock still -7.49%) is the market's clearest signal: premium multiples cannot absorb growth scare narratives regardless of fundamental performance. The Korea semiconductor circuit breaker (KOSPI -4.45%, SK Hynix -10.96%) demonstrates that AI supply chain confidence is more fragile than June's 80%+ gains implied. If SPX reclaims 7,460 on July 7, the bear case is wrong.
